# USD Immigration — machine-readable site summary (experimental; see https://llmstxt.org/)

> Niagara Falls, Ontario-based Canadian immigration consulting. Public marketing site only — not legal advice.

## Canonical origin
https://usdimmigration.ca

## What we do
- Canadian immigration strategy and application support: Express Entry, OINP (Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program), work permits (including LMIA and LMIA-exempt routes), study permits, family and spousal sponsorship, visitor and Super Visa, citizenship, and related pathways.
- Office: 4838 Dorchester Rd, Niagara Falls, ON L2E 6N9, Canada.
- Consultations: in person (Niagara office) or remote for clients across Ontario.

## Geographic focus
- Niagara Region and Greater Toronto Area (GTA), including regular work with clients in Niagara Falls, St. Catharines, Welland, Fort Erie, Grimsby, Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Hamilton, Oakville, Markham, Vaughan, and neighbouring Ontario communities.

## Limitations
